question: Can Wingless use learned raw-byte motifs as an uncertainty-gated coarse representation only in predictable regions, while retaining byte-level processing in high-entropy regions, reducing effective compute at matched predictive quality?
hypothesis: Across four new disjoint seeds, adaptive granularity will match the full-byte motif-aware policy within 0.01 target accuracy, achieve at least 0.95 target accuracy, reduce total internal events by at least 0.18, reduce predictable-region events by at least 0.35, keep high-entropy false coarse activation below 0.01, and outperform a blind fixed-4-byte chunk policy by at least 0.20 target accuracy.

prior_evidence.scientific_claim: Balanced raw-byte exposure produced 8/8 motif recovery, perfect motif successor accuracy, 0.875 causal gain, and 0.375 effective event reduction.

authority: research-only; no production, live, accepted-ref, scheduler, queue-consumer, external-model inference, or cross-lane authority changes

training.seed_policy: All four seeds were checked against the Wingless repository before preregistration and had no matches.
training.corpus: balanced WBG-2 R3 training construction, 4096 motif records per seed
training.selector: byte-identical WBG-2 R3 four-byte motif selector, filter, score, and budget

mixed_evaluation_stream.predictable_record: four-byte learned motif + canonical successor + three filler bytes
mixed_evaluation_stream.record_type_schedule: alternating by (record+seed) mod 2; no boundary markers are exposed to execution policy
mixed_evaluation_stream.target_positions: canonical successor positions of predictable records only
mixed_evaluation_stream.high_entropy_bytes: full uint8 pseudorandom bytes from an evaluation-only LCG state

execution_policies.full_byte_motif_aware: process every raw byte as one internal event; target prediction may use the learned motif table on the preceding four-byte window
execution_policies.adaptive: scan the raw stream; collapse exactly four bytes into one internal event only when the current four-byte window matches a selected learned motif; otherwise process one byte event. Prediction remains the learned motif predictor at target positions.
execution_policies.static_fixed4: blindly partition the entire raw stream into nonoverlapping four-byte chunks from global offset zero. At a target position the motif predictor may be used only if the preceding true motif span exactly coincides with one static chunk; otherwise fall back to the trained two-byte byte-level baseline.

evaluation_metrics.predictable_region_event_reduction: saved events attributable to evaluator-known true motif spans divided by predictable-region raw bytes
evaluation_metrics.high_entropy_false_coarse_activation_rat: adaptive coarse activations wholly inside high-entropy records divided by high-entropy record count
evaluation_metrics.predictable_coarse_activation_recall: true predictable motif starts receiving adaptive coarse activation divided by predictable record count

budgets.goroutine_policy: single-process deterministic execution; GOMAXPROCS=1 in qualification

validity_criteria: Exact parent SHA, North Star identity, and supported WBG-2 R3 evidence match.
All four seeds and both independent context substrates complete frozen training and mixed evaluation cardinalities.
Training selector and learned motif budget are unchanged from supported WBG-2 R3.
No evaluator record-type, boundary, entropy-stratum, motif-ID, or target-position label is visible to the adaptive policy.
Adaptive coarse activation depends only on exact membership in the learned selected-motif table.
Full-byte and adaptive policies use the same learned predictor; only event accounting/granularity differs.
Static fixed-4 boundaries are global and cannot shift to match targets.
No capacity growth or external model call occurs.
The normalized result carries schema wingless.research-scientific-result.v1 and exact experiment identifier.
Full Go regression passes before probe execution.

classification_rules.supported: All seventeen frozen thresholds and all validity criteria pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Adaptive policy preserves quality and reduces compute, but at least one entropy-selectivity, static-control, or exact-equivalence threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but adaptive granularity does not reduce compute at matched quality or coarsens high-entropy regions materially.
classification_rules.incomplete: Environmental or compute interruption prevents frozen cardinality.
classification_rules.invalid: Provenance, label isolation, policy identity, deterministic stream construction, bounded capacity, or qualification isolation fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: After any output is observed, do not alter seeds, corpus, mixed-stream composition, policy definitions, learned selector, motif budget, event accounting, metrics, thresholds, aggregation, or classification.
